cross_layer_rules: C wraps A: you arrive at ORIGIN, ENTER 00 into the WAITING ROOM, and EXIT 00 back out
B is present inside A, D, E, F with context-specific content
G serves every layer and is never navigated to
H mounts project outputs inside E (live review) and F (runtime preview)
Project management lives in E/F/F2, never in D
